name: Zhao (Warring States)
alt: Zhao of the Seven Warring States

predecessors.name: Jin (Chinese state)
predecessors.text: the Cliopatria Zhao shape without Zheng's land, Shangdang, the wei dossier's discs, with Jinyang (the corrected K0)

successors.name: Qin (state)
successors.text: Dai (modern Yu County, Hebei), where Prince Jia was proclaimed king in 228

ledger.x: 403: the Zhou king recognises Zhao with Han and Wei.
386: Marquess Jing moves the capital to Handan.
376: 'In 376 BC, the states of Han, Wei and Zhao deposed Duke Jing of Jin' and divided the last Jin territory; the Spring and Autumn table gives 'Jin...
366: Cliopatria's Zhongshan row begins with 62 cells that were in Zhao's 367 shape.
350: Cliopatria gives Zhao 79 cells of Wei's Hebei shape (the Zhao page: 'in 354 BC...
350: Cliopatria passes 38 cells of Zhao's shape to Qin.
350: Cliopatria passes 22 cells of Han's shape to Zhao (mirror of han L7).
350: Cliopatria passes 15 cells of Zhao's shape to Han (mirror of han L6).
337: Cliopatria passes 76 cells of Zhao's shape to Qin.
307: Zhao attacks Zhongshan.
306: Zhao takes the northern lands.
305: parts of Zhongshan are annexed.
304: Zhao takes the upper Yellow River from the Hu.
296: Zhao annexes Zhongshan.
296: the fighting for Zhongshan ends with the annexation.
262: Zhao receives Han's Shangdang.
April 262: the Zhao and Qin armies first meet.
260: Qin destroys the Zhao army at Changping.
260: Shangdang passes to Qin after Changping.
late 259: Qin besieges Handan.
257: the siege of Handan is lifted.
247: Cliopatria gives Zhao 30 cells of Wey's last shape.
236: Qin takes nine Zhao cities.
229: Qin attacks the Zhao capital.
228: Handan falls and King Youmiao is taken.
228: Prince Jia sets up the Zhao court at Dai.
222: the last Zhao resistance ends at Dai.
222: Qin conquers Dai and Zhao ends.

wars.name: Battle of Guiling and Wei's invasion of Zhao
wars.outcome: 'This struggle came to a head in 354 BC when Wei invaded Zhao, forcing Zhao to seek help from Qi.'

wars.name: Zhao's conquest of Zhongshan
wars.outcome: Zhao victory: 'From 307 BC on, Zhao attacked Zhongshan almost every year'; several cities in 307, parts annexed in 305, the king took refuge in Qi in 301, the state annexed in 296 (295 on the Zhao page).

wars.name: Zhao's northern expansion
wars.outcome: Zhao took the Loufan and Linhu lands (306) and the upper Yellow River from the Hu (304) and created the prefectures of Yunzhong and Jiuyuan (302).

wars.name: Battle of Changping
wars.outcome: Qin victory: Zhao took Han's Shangdang in 262 and lost its army at Changping in 260.

wars.name: Siege of Handan
wars.outcome: Zhao, with Wei and Chu, held off Qin in 257.

wars.name: Qin's conquest of Zhao
wars.outcome: Qin took nine cities in 236 (Ye and Anyang among them), Chili and Yi'an in 233 (Li Mu retook Yi'an), Langmeng in 232, and Handan and King Youmiao in 228.

wars.name: Qin's conquest of Dai
wars.outcome: Qin victory: Prince Jia's regime at Dai fell in 222.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line is on any page; the frontiers with Wei, Han, Qin, Yan and the steppe are approximate throughout, and the corrected shapes mix Cliopatria cells with discs around named places.
